description: Explicit correction candidates for the 16 archived failed inputs. Only enumerated FRETish clauses change; all IDs, source references, kinds, variable declarations, roles, meanings, time models, and solver options remain identical. These are not new archived jobs or evidence of source/implementation correctness.

requirements.fretish: WrapperRetrieval shall always satisfy (returned_none <-> !has_wrapper).

variables.name: has_wrapper
variables.meaning: The supplied environment wrapper chain contains the specified wrapper class.

variables.name: returned_none
variables.meaning: The unwrap_wrapper result is None.

time_model.description: Each step observes the inputs and result of one completed unwrap_wrapper invocation; this logical observation model adds no physical duration or call-completion bound.

changes.before: WrapperRetrieval shall always satisfy returned_none = !has_wrapper.
changes.after: WrapperRetrieval shall always satisfy (returned_none <-> !has_wrapper).
changes.rationale: Express the intended Boolean equality with FRET's equivalence operator; preserve both directions of the absence relation.

remaining_gaps: The Bool abstraction only captures result absence; wrapper identity, traversal order, termination, and implementation observations remain outside it.

requirements.fretish: StickyActionEnv shall satisfy executed_action = previous_action | executed_action = intended_action.
whenever repeat_probability = 0.0 StickyActionEnv shall satisfy executed_action = intended_action.
whenever repeat_probability = 1.0 StickyActionEnv shall satisfy executed_action = previous_action.

variables.name: repeat_probability
variables.meaning: Configured sticky-action selection probability.

variables.name: previous_action
variables.meaning: Previous action available for repetition at this observed step; history extraction is outside this projection.

variables.name: intended_action
variables.meaning: Intended new action supplied to step.

variables.name: executed_action
variables.meaning: Action executed at the observed step.

time_model.description: One logical observation per completed step call, pairing configured probability and intended/previous actions with the executed action; no physical timing or probabilistic trace measure is asserted.

changes.before: StickyActionEnv whenever repeat_probability = 0 shall satisfy executed_action = intended_action.
changes.after: whenever repeat_probability = 0.0 StickyActionEnv shall satisfy executed_action = intended_action.
changes.rationale: Place the condition before the component and spell zero as a real literal for the unchanged real probability declaration; preserve the zero-probability endpoint.

changes.before: StickyActionEnv whenever repeat_probability = 1 shall satisfy executed_action = previous_action.
changes.after: whenever repeat_probability = 1.0 StickyActionEnv shall satisfy executed_action = previous_action.
changes.rationale: Place the condition before the component and spell one as a real literal; preserve the certainty endpoint.

remaining_gaps: This retains allowed actions and the probability-0/1 endpoints, not intermediate probability distribution or sampling independence.
previous_action is an independent input snapshot; cross-step history binding and the probability input domain are not established by this model.

requirements.fretish: whenever total > 0.0 TrainingProgress shall immediately satisfy remaining = 1.0 - current / total.

variables.name: current
variables.meaning: Current timestep argument of one progress update.

variables.name: total
variables.meaning: Total timestep argument of one progress update.

variables.name: remaining
variables.meaning: Progress remaining computed by that update.

time_model.description: Each logical step is one completed call to the progress update; no physical-time sampling or deadline is introduced.

changes.before: whenever total > 0 TrainingProgress shall immediately satisfy remaining = 1 - current / total.
changes.after: whenever total > 0.0 TrainingProgress shall immediately satisfy remaining = 1.0 - current / total.
changes.rationale: Both comparison zero and subtraction one must be real literals because total/current/remaining are declared real. Preserve the complete division relation and positive-total guard.

remaining_gaps: This retains the complete guarded arithmetic relation over Reals, not merely endpoint behavior.
The model does not establish integral timesteps, input domain beyond the existing positive-total guard, call completion, or actual implementation observations.

requirements.fretish: CallbackLifecycle shall always satisfy (lifecycle_event => hook_called).

variables.name: lifecycle_event
variables.meaning: A training or rollout start/end event occurs in this dispatch observation.

variables.name: hook_called
variables.meaning: The corresponding public lifecycle callback is invoked at this dispatch.

time_model.description: Each step is a training lifecycle dispatch observation, not a physical-time interval.

changes.before: CallbackLifecycle shall always satisfy (lifecycle_event implies hook_called).
changes.after: CallbackLifecycle shall always satisfy (lifecycle_event => hook_called).
changes.rationale: Use FRET's implication token for the same one-way dispatch obligation.

remaining_gaps: The aggregate event/hook booleans do not distinguish each lifecycle hook's identity, order, arguments, or actual invocation.

requirements.fretish: EventComposition shall always satisfy ((child_present & event_dispatch) => child_called).
EventComposition shall always satisfy ((child_present & event_dispatch) => (event_result = child_result)).

variables.name: child_present
variables.meaning: An event child callback is configured.

variables.name: event_dispatch
variables.meaning: _on_event is being dispatched.

variables.name: child_result
variables.meaning: Boolean returned by the configured child's on_step.

variables.name: child_called
variables.meaning: The child's on_step is invoked in this dispatch.

variables.name: event_result
variables.meaning: Boolean returned by _on_event.

time_model.description: Each step observes an event callback dispatch and its return, not physical time.

changes.before: EventComposition shall always satisfy ((child_present and event_dispatch) implies child_called).
changes.after: EventComposition shall always satisfy ((child_present & event_dispatch) => child_called).
changes.rationale: Use FRET conjunction and implication tokens without changing the conjunction or its consequent.

changes.before: EventComposition shall always satisfy ((child_present and event_dispatch) implies (event_result = child_result)).
changes.after: EventComposition shall always satisfy ((child_present & event_dispatch) => (event_result = child_result)).
changes.rationale: Use FRET conjunction and implication tokens; retain the Boolean result equality.

remaining_gaps: The abstraction retains dispatch and Boolean child-result forwarding, not object identity, actual child invocation, arguments, or ordering.

requirements.fretish: ListComposition shall always satisfy ((list_step & any_child_false) => !list_result).

variables.name: list_step
variables.meaning: A callback-list step dispatch is occurring.

variables.name: any_child_false
variables.meaning: At least one invoked member returned False in this dispatch.

variables.name: list_result

changes.before: ListComposition shall always satisfy ((list_step and any_child_false) implies !list_result).
changes.after: ListComposition shall always satisfy ((list_step & any_child_false) => !list_result).
changes.rationale: Use FRET conjunction and implication tokens; retain the negative list-result obligation.

remaining_gaps: The aggregate any_child_false predicate must be independently observed; member ordering, invoking every member, and the all-true return case are not specified by this single implication.

changes.before: VecMonitorReset shall always satisfy ((episode_return = 0) & (episode_length = 0)).
changes.after: VecMonitorReset shall always satisfy ((episode_return = 0.0) & (episode_length = 0)).
changes.rationale: Only episode_return is real; its zero becomes 0.0 while the integer episode_length and its zero remain unchanged.

remaining_gaps: The snapshot model only checks cleared scalar counters for an arbitrary environment; it does not model vector shape, every environment, call termination, or subsequent accumulation.

requirements.fretish: ResultsFilter shall always satisfy (cutoff_supplied => (passes_timestep_filter <-> (point_timesteps < cutoff))).

changes.after: ResultsFilter shall always satisfy (cutoff_supplied => (passes_timestep_filter <-> (point_timesteps < cutoff))).
changes.rationale: Use Boolean equivalence to compare the predicate with the integer comparison; preserve the strict less-than cutoff and both truth directions.

remaining_gaps: The arbitrary-point model retains strict cutoff eligibility and no-cutoff behavior; it does not model collection ordering, complete point enumeration, or plotting effects.

requirements.fretish: whenever initializing_squared_average RMSpropTFLikeNumerics shall immediately satisfy squared_average_initial = 1.0.
whenever step_return & closure_provided RMSpropTFLikeNumerics shall immediately satisfy returned_loss = closure_loss & !returns_none.
whenever step_return & !closure_provided RMSpropTFLikeNumerics shall immediately satisfy returns_none.

whenever step_return RMSpropTFLikeNumerics shall immediately satisfy effective_gradient = raw_gradient + weight_decay * old_parameter & squared_average = alpha * old_squared_average + (1.0 - alpha) * effective_gradient * effective_gradient.
whenever step_return & centered RMSpropTFLikeNumerics shall immediately satisfy gradient_average = alpha * old_gradient_average + (1.0 - alpha) * effective_gradient.
whenever step_return & !centered & (squared_average + eps >= 0.0) RMSpropTFLikeNumerics shall immediately satisfy denominator >= 0.0 & denominator * denominator = squared_average + eps.

whenever step_return & (denominator > 0.0) & (momentum != 0.0) RMSpropTFLikeNumerics shall immediately satisfy new_buffer = momentum * old_buffer + effective_gradient / denominator & new_parameter = old_parameter - lr * new_buffer.

requirements.fretish: whenever strategy_code = 0 HerGoals shall immediately satisfy same_episode & selected_step > current_step.
whenever strategy_code = 1 HerGoals shall immediately satisfy same_episode & selected_step = last_step.
whenever strategy_code = 2 HerGoals shall immediately satisfy same_episode.

variables.name: strategy_code
variables.meaning: Configured strategy code: FUTURE=0, FINAL=1, EPISODE=2.

variables.name: current_step
variables.meaning: Current transition's episode-relative step position, not its circular buffer index.

variables.name: last_step
variables.meaning: Episode-relative position of the final achieved goal.

variables.name: selected_step
variables.meaning: Episode-relative position at which the returned goal was achieved.

variables.name: same_episode
variables.meaning: Returned achieved goal belongs to the indexed transition's episode.

time_model.description: One logical step per completed goal selection for a representative indexed transition. Episode-relative positions describe where the selected goal was achieved, not physical elapsed time.

changes.before: HerGoals whenever strategy_code = 0 shall immediately satisfy same_episode & selected_step > current_step.
changes.after: whenever strategy_code = 0 HerGoals shall immediately satisfy same_episode & selected_step > current_step.
changes.rationale: Place the condition before the component; retain strategy 0 and the strictly-future relation without adding episode bounds.

changes.before: HerGoals whenever strategy_code = 1 shall immediately satisfy same_episode & selected_step = last_step.
changes.after: whenever strategy_code = 1 HerGoals shall immediately satisfy same_episode & selected_step = last_step.
changes.rationale: Place the condition before the component; retain strategy 1 and final-step equality.

changes.before: HerGoals whenever strategy_code = 2 shall immediately satisfy same_episode.
changes.after: whenever strategy_code = 2 HerGoals shall immediately satisfy same_episode.
changes.rationale: Place the condition before the component; retain strategy 2 and same-episode guarantee.

remaining_gaps: The strict future-step relation is preserved; finite episode bounds and whether a future step exists are not added as assumptions.
Goal identity, sampling distribution, circular-buffer binding, and actual observations remain outside this integer/Bool abstraction.
